blocks.text: Sequence homology ka matlab hai DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ka aapas mein milta julta hona, kyunke woh ek hi purane ajdaad (shared ancestry) se aaye hain. Homologous sequences ek hi purane (ancestral) sequence se badal badal kar bane hain. In ki do badi qismein hain:

items: Orthologs: mukhtalif species mein woh sequences jo speciation (nayi species banne) ke waqt ek hi ancestral gene se nikle. Orthologs aksar har species mein wahi kaam karte rehte hain.
Paralogs: ek hi species ke andar woh sequences jo gene duplication (gene ki doosri copy banne) se nikle. Paralogs ek hi ancestral gene se aane ke bawajood naye kaam seekh (evolve kar) sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen se daen parha jane wala darakht (tree). Ancestral Histone H1 gene, Gene duplication ki lakeer par, Histone H1.1 (surkh) aur Histone H1.2 (neela) mein batta hai. Speciation ki lakeer par har naql Human aur Chimpanzee mein jati hai: Human histone H1.1, Human histone H1.2, Chimpanzee histone H1.1, Chimpanzee histone H1.2. Chhota bracket do insani genes ko Paralog, lamba bracket Human aur Chimpanzee H1.1 ko Ortholog kehta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.6: Homologous sequences ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 7.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle ek gene ki do copies banin (gene duplication): H1.1 aur H1.2. Phir species alag huin (speciation). Ek hi jandar mein duplication se bani copies paralogs hain (insaan ka H1.1 aur H1.2). Mukhtalif species mein ek hi ancestral gene se aaye genes orthologs hain (insaan ka H1.1 aur chimpanzee ka H1.1).

Sequence homology se jandaron ke evolutionary rishte samajh aate hain. Homologous sequences ka muqabla kar ke scientists andaza laga sakte hain ke species ki evolutionary history kya hai aur woh kab alag huin (divergence). Sequence homology kisi anjaan gene ya protein ke kaam ka ishara bhi deti hai: agar anjaan gene/protein kisi aise gene/protein ka homologous ho jis ka kaam maloom hai, to us ka kaam bhi shayad waisa hi hoga. Mukhtalif species mein beemariyon se jude homologous genes pehchanne se beemari ka tareeqa (mechanism) samajhne aur ilaj banane mein madad milti hai. Model organisms (jin jandaron par tajurbe kiye jate hain) ke homologous genes parh kar insani beemariyon ki samajh hasil ki ja sakti hai.

Structural homology ka matlab hai proteins ya doosre macromolecules ki 3D structures ka milta julta hona, kyunke woh ek hi ajdaad se aaye hain. Milti julti structure wale proteins aksar milta julta kaam karte hain, chahe un ke sequences zyada na milte hon. Protein ki 3D structure us ke kaam ke baare mein bohat aham maloomat deti hai. Structural homology samajh kar naye dhoonde gaye proteins ke kaam ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai. Dawa banane (drug design) mein bhi yeh bohat zaroori hai, kyunke dawaein aksar khaas protein structures se judne ke liye banai jati hain; proteins ke structural rishte samajh kar zyada asar wali dawaein banai ja sakti hain. Proteins ki structural homology parhne se un evolutionary amal ki samajh bhi aati hai jo proteins ke kaam aur rabton ko shakal dete hain.

blocks.alt: Upar baen Template protein, helices ka neela gattha; upar daen Unknown Structure surmai rang mein bara sawaliya nishan ke saath. Har ek ke neeche us ka amino acid sequence. Teer Sequence Alignment tak jate hain jahan dono sequences khali jagahon (gaps) ke saath barabar rakhe gaye hain aur ek gulabi hissa mukhtalif hai. Aakhri teer Computed Structure Model tak jata hai, halka neela helix gattha gulabi loop ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.7: Protein ki structural homology (kitab ki Figure 7.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jis protein ki structure maloom nahi, us ka sequence ek maloom structure wale protein (template) ke sequence se milaya jata hai. Jahan sequence milta hai wahan structure bhi milti julti mani jati hai, is liye computer template ki shakal par naye protein ka model bana deta hai. Gulabi hissa woh jagah hai jo template se mukhtalif hai.

blocks.caption: Sequence homology aur structural homology ka muqabla
rows: Nucleotides ya amino acids ki tarteeb (sequence)
Orthologs (mukhtalif species, speciation se); paralogs (ek species, duplication se)
Sequence alag hon tab bhi structure mil sakti hai
Evolutionary history; anjaan gene ka kaam; model organisms se beemari ki samajh
Naye protein ka kaam; drug design; protein ke kaam ka evolution

blocks.prompt: Do proteins ke amino acid sequences bohat kam milte hain, magar dono ek hi shakal mein fold hote hain aur ek hi dawa se judte hain. Yeh kaun si homology hai, aur is se un ke kaam aur ajdaad ke baare mein kya pata chalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh structural homology hai: dono ki 3D shakal is liye milti hai ke dono ek hi purane protein se aaye hain, halanke waqt ke saath sequences badal gaye. Milti julti structure ka matlab milta julta kaam hai; isi liye ek hi dawa dono mein fit hoti hai, aur isi liye drug design mein structural rishte kaam aate hain.

items: Sequence homology: ek hi ajdaad se aane ki wajah se DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ka milna. Orthologs (mukhtalif species, speciation se, aksar wahi kaam); paralogs (ek species, gene duplication se, naya kaam bhi seekh sakte hain).
Is se evolutionary rishte, anjaan gene ka kaam, aur model organisms se insani beemari ki samajh milti hai.
Structural homology: ek hi ajdaad se 3D structure ka milna; milti structure aksar milta kaam, chahe sequence na mile. Faide: naye protein ka kaam, drug design, protein ke kaam ka evolution.
